title.en: Mobile Library Stock and Activities Assistant
title.zh: 流动图书馆藏书与活动助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Prepare stop-specific bookstock and reconcile crates using approved lists.
requirements.zh: 依据获批清单准备各停靠点专用藏书，并核对图书箱。

requirements.en: Process loans and returns and assist visitors with reservations within supplied account procedures.
requirements.zh: 依据所提供账户流程处理借还，并协助访客预约事项。

requirements.en: Prepare and recover activity materials and support librarian-led visitor sessions.
requirements.zh: 准备并回收活动材料，支持图书馆员主持的访客活动。

requirements.en: Maintain session attendance records and useful end-of-route handovers.
requirements.zh: 维护活动出席记录及实用的路线结束交接。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently design and evaluate age-appropriate reading programmes.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立设计并评估适龄阅读项目。
